title: Wesley Medical Center — FDA 실사 관찰사항 API (실사 종료 2024-12-10)
source_summary: Failure to notify transfusion recipients who received previous collections of blood and blood components at increased risk of transmitting HCV infection and the physician of record for transfusion recipients who received previous collections of blood and blood components at increased risk of transmitting HCV infection of the need for recipient HCV testing and counseling.
change_summary: FDA API 관찰사항 자료 3건을 동일 실사로 묶었습니다. 현재 조회한 공식 목록에서 일치하는 Form 483 PDF를 찾지 못했습니다. 아래 API 관찰사항은 확인할 수 있지만 PDF 전문을 검토한 요약은 아닙니다.
